self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Hope Beyond the Peaks (R5): after nearby party members use Elemental Skills, the wielder's Elemental Skill DMG is further increased by 24% for 8s (stacking on top of the always-on +24%). Climbing Stamina reduction not modeled (non-combat).

en.flavor: This polearm was once jointly forged by the craftsmen in the mines as a sacrifice to the spirits of the mountains.

refinements.1: Decreases Climbing Stamina Consumption by 15% and increases Elemental Skill DMG by <r>12%</r>. Also, after other nearby party members use Elemental Skills, the equipping character's Elemental Skill DMG will also increase by <r>12%</r> for 8s.

fr.flavor: Cette arme d'hast était autrefois fabriquée par des artisans dans les mines pour servir de sacrifice aux esprits des montagnes.
